selected_beats.action_beat: The Narrator sits hunched and weary at a heavy desk, surrounded by a chaotic pile of ancient, leather-bound volumes of forgotten lore. A single, flickering candle provides the only light, casting long, trembling shadows across the room.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Medium shot, side profile, heavy chiaroscuro lighting.

selected_beats.action_beat: A close-up of a dying fire in the hearth; the last glowing embers pulse with a deep amber light, casting "ghostly" shadows that dance erratically across the dark floorboards.

The Narrator stands in a state of sudden tension, his eyes wide with fear. In the background, heavy purple silk curtains rustle unnaturally in the gloom, their rich texture catching the dim, flickering light.

The Narrator stands at the threshold of the open door, peering into a void of absolute, impenetrable darkness. His silhouette is sharply defined against the warm, dim light of the chamber, facing the terrifying emptiness of the night.

The Narrator flings open the window shutter to reveal a stately, ebony Raven that has stepped inside; the bird perches with a lordly, commanding presence atop a pale marble bust of Pallas Athena situated above the chamber door.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Low angle, wide shot. High-contrast moonlight streaming through the open shutter, creating a stark silhouette of the bird against the white marble.

selected_beats.action_beat: A close-up of the Raven's countenance, revealing a grim, ancient, and stern expression; the bird's feathers are highly textured and dark, appearing almost sculptural in the gloom.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Close-up. Tenebrism lighting, with intense highlights on the bird's beak and eye, leaving the rest of the frame in deep, velvety shadow.

selected_beats.action_beat: The Raven sits in absolute, lonely stillness upon the placid, pale bust of Pallas, a dark and motionless figure set against the deep midnight blue and ebony shadows of the chamber.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Medium shot, centered on the bust. Moody, low-key lighting with faint, flickering amber light catching the edge of the marble.

selected_beats.action_beat: The Narrator wheels a plush, violet velvet chair into the center of the room, sitting heavily upon it. He is positioned directly in front of the grim, gaunt Raven perched upon the pale marble bust, his silhouette framed by deep ebony shadows.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Medium shot, side profile, high-contrast Chiaroscuro.

selected_beats.action_beat: An extreme close-up of the Raven's eyes, which burn with an unnatural, fiery amber light. Below, the lamp-light glints off the rich, tactile texture of the violet velvet lining of the chair, creating a sense of heavy, suffocating luxury.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Close-up, shallow depth of field, heavy Tenebrism.

selected_beats.action_beat: The air in the chamber becomes thick and heavy with swirling plumes of incense smoke. The smoke catches the flickering amber light, forming ghostly, ethereal shapes that suggest the movement of unseen Seraphim through the darkness.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Wide shot, low angle, looking through a haze of smoke and shadow.

selected_beats.action_beat: The Narrator, looking haggard and desperate, leans forward into the light. His face is a mask of anguish and madness, half-submerged in deep shadow, as he cries out toward the darkness in a moment of profound spiritual desperation.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Close-up, dramatic low angle, high-contrast lighting.

selected_beats.action_beat: The Narrator upstarting in a frantic, desperate movement, his face contorted in a mixture of grief and fury as he shrieks at the bird.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Medium shot, low angle, dramatic side-lighting (tenebrism) to emphasize the tension in his posture and the heavy texture of his velvet robes.

selected_beats.action_beat: The black Raven perched motionless atop the pallid, cold marble bust of Pallas; a single lamp-light casts a sharp, dark shadow of the bird across the floor.
selected_beats.camera_framing: Close-up, high-contrast lighting, focusing on the tactile contrast between the bird's ebony feathers and the smooth, white marble.
